title: Murkclaw & Gravecrow
text: Legendary Follower / Companion. Unique. A breach-touched warcat and omen-crow pair joins the operative, scouting danger windows, rattling enemies, and marking routes that smell wrong.
flavor: The cat sees what wants to eat you. The crow tells it where to wait.
resolutionSummary: Murkclaw & Gravecrow padded out of the smoke and chose the active operative as their current bad decision.

effects.text: Murkclaw & Gravecrow acquired: legendary companion pair, once per round omen support.

imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi companion card showing a huge blue-black breach-touched cat with glowing orange eyes, tiny fangs, spiked black armor, red gem ward harness, and a small black-and-white gravecrow wearing a little top hat perched between its ears. They stand together in a ruined gothic-industrial battlefield under red ember skies, cute but dangerous, dark brass, violet shadow light, cinematic Ashen Reach card art, no text.
